outcome: Large for gestational age birth weight
Small for gestational age birth weight
cohort: 8,628 nulliparous women from the Nulliparous Pregnancy Outcomes Study: Monitoring Mothers-To-Be (NuMoM2b) study
finding: Both excessive and inadequate gestational weight gain are associated with adverse maternal and neonatal outcomes.
mod_finding: Excessive gestational weight gain was associated with higher odds of Cesarean delivery, while inadequate gestational weight gain was associated with lower odds of Cesarean delivery.
